notes.title: v2.1
notes.content:
Hi,

I have made numerous little changes.
Here are the major changes:

- Cheats are now hidden: press S (keyboard) or LB (Xbox controller) to access it
- chapter select and fight select are considered as cheats
- fight select are normal fights (no escape and gameover when defeat)
- add a secret shop with holy weapons as cheats, these are C rank so everyone can equip them
- after the ending, the game propose to go to bonus chapter
- The option to gain exp and gold when skipping are turn to off by default.
- Jezebel fight is harder.

Some notes:

To win the bonus chapter fights, you may use the secret shop.
Fastest way to gain exp and gold:
use chapter select (cheats) and go to bonus 2, turn on the option to gain exp and gold when skipping fight and then pass the chapter, you will gain around 1000 exp and 7000 gold. Repeat as much as you like.

notes.title: v2 version
notes.content:
Hi folks! Some users had concerns about difficulty and cheats, and here is a major update.

- Most of the cheats has been removed. 
- A lot of suplerfuous options has been removed
so it is less confusing.
- The game is considerably harder but you can toggle difficulty
between: very easy, easy, normal, hard and very hard.

People who play for the story should play in Very easy
(it is easy but not too much).
Normal mode can be pretty chalenging too.
Some fights in Very hard may be really difficult to win.

I wanted to include many options and cheats so player
can freely adapt their playstyle but it was really confusing.
Now this version is how the game was intended to be played.

Enjoy!
